_note: Fictional demo tickets for Agent C. People and systems are invented.

tickets.title: Checkout returns HTTP 500 when coupon is removed
tickets.description: POST /api/cart/checkout fails with 500 after the user applies and then removes a coupon. Stack trace shows TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for -: 'float' and 'NoneType' in pricing/discounts.py apply_discount. Started after release 4.12.0.

tickets.title: Login redirect loop with expired session cookie
tickets.description: Users with an expired session cookie are redirected between /login and /dashboard indefinitely. Clearing cookies fixes it. Affects Safari 18 and Chrome 131. Middleware does not clear the stale cookie.

tickets.title: Password reset emails not delivered for Outlook domains
tickets.description: Reset emails to outlook.com and hotmail.com addresses are never received. SMTP logs show 550 5.7.1 rejection: SPF check failed for mail-02 relay.

tickets.title: Search results page slow for queries with special characters
tickets.description: Search latency exceeds 8 seconds when the query contains '&' or '%'. The ORM builds an unindexed LIKE query instead of using the full-text index.

tickets.title: Mobile app crashes on Android 15 when opening order history
tickets.description: NullPointerException in OrderHistoryAdapter.onBindViewHolder when an order has no shipping address (digital goods). Crash rate 2.3% of Android 15 sessions.

tickets.title: Inventory count goes negative under concurrent purchases
tickets.description: During the flash sale two customers bought the last unit of SKU HOM-502. inventory.quantity became -1. The decrement is done in application code after a separate SELECT, not atomically.

tickets.title: CSV export truncates rows after 10,000
tickets.description: Admin order export silently stops at 10,000 rows. Pagination loop exits when page size equals the hard-coded limit.

tickets.title: Dark mode: unreadable text on payment form
tickets.description: In dark mode the card number placeholder is #222 on #1e1e1e background. Fails WCAG contrast.

tickets.title: API rate limiter blocks legitimate webhook retries
tickets.description: Payment provider webhook retries are rejected with 429 because the rate limiter keys on source IP and the provider uses a shared egress IP.

tickets.title: Session tokens logged in plaintext in access logs
tickets.description: The nginx access log format includes the full Authorization header. Tokens are visible to anyone with log access. Security issue.

tickets.title: Coupon code field accepts expired coupons
tickets.description: Expired coupon SAVE20 is still accepted at checkout. The expiry check compares naive local time with UTC timestamps.

tickets.title: Image uploads fail for HEIC files from iPhone
tickets.description: Uploading .heic product photos returns 'unsupported format'. Converter library lacks libheif.

tickets.title: Duplicate order confirmation emails
tickets.description: Some customers receive two confirmation emails. The email job is enqueued in both the order service and the payment webhook handler.

tickets.title: Timeouts calling shipping rates API during peak hours
tickets.description: GET /shipping/rates times out after 30s at peak. No circuit breaker or cache; each cart refresh triggers a new external call.

tickets.title: Checkout total wrong when gift card and coupon combined
tickets.description: Applying a gift card after a percentage coupon double-counts the discount. Rounding happens before the coupon is applied.

tickets.title: Memory leak in recommendation worker
tickets.description: Worker RSS grows 200MB/hour until OOM-killed. Heap snapshot shows an unbounded LRU cache keyed by session id.
